description: Weight perturbation of the frozen canonical MCDA: one-at-a-time (OAT) steps and Dirichlet sampling around the baseline weights. Baseline weights come from config/mcda_weights.tsv (scenario baseline); nothing frozen is changed.
random_stream: numpy.random.default_rng([seed, kappa]) (PCG64); Dirichlet(alpha = kappa * baseline weights); rows are drawn in one call per kappa and the sampled weights are stored in weight_samples.csv
oat_rule: w_i' = w_i (1 + step); every other weight is multiplied by (1 - w_i') / (1 - w_i), so the weights still sum to one
